comparison.objective: Prune a selected dead rose stem and retain the cutting for disposal; candidate extracts a terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Target discrimination, shear-tool positioning, cutting and bimanual capture versus latch release with a blade and wire pull.
comparison.success_condition: Correct stem cut at the prescribed location and cutting placed in bin without drop/damage to plant; candidate requires selective terminal removal. Candidate numeric thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: Cutting and debris capture test different abilities from depinning.
